verse_of_the_day.text: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: God loves everyone in the whole world so much! He loves you more than you can ever imagine. Because He loves us, He gave us His Son, Jesus, as the best gift ever. When we believe in Jesus and follow Him, we get to be part of God's family forever. Always remember that you are very special to God.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, thank You for loving me so much. Thank You for sending Jesus to be my Savior. Help me to love You back with all my heart. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Tell someone today that God loves them. You can draw a picture of a big heart, write 'God Loves You' on it, and give it to a friend or family member!

verse_of_the_day.text: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever been in a dark room? It is hard to see where to walk, and you might bump into things! The Bible is like a bright flashlight. When we read it, God’s words help us see the right way to go. It shows us how to make good choices every single day.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, thank You for giving us the Bible. Please help me to read it and learn from it. Let Your words be like a flashlight that guides my steps today. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Ask an adult to help you find and read a short story from the Bible today, like the story of David or Noah. Talk about what the story teaches you!

verse_of_the_day.text: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Sometimes things happen that we do not understand. Maybe we feel sad, or something is too hard to figure out. This verse tells us that we don't need to know all the answers. We just need to trust God. Trusting God means believing that He is good, He is big, and He will always take care of us.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, sometimes I don't understand why things happen. But I know that You are good and You love me. Help me to trust You completely, even when things are hard. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: If you feel worried or confused today, take a deep breath and say out loud: 'I will trust You, God!' Let that remind you that God is in control.

verse_of_the_day.text: I can do all this through him who gives me strength.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Do you ever feel like something is just too hard to do? Maybe it's a hard math problem, or maybe you are nervous about trying something new. God promises to give us strength! We don't have to be super strong on our own because Jesus shares His power with us when we ask Him.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, thank You for making me strong. Whenever I feel weak or scared, remind me that You are with me. Help me to do my best today because You are helping me. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Think of one thing that feels hard for you right now. Before you try to do it today, pray a quick prayer asking Jesus to give you the strength to keep going!

verse_of_the_day.text: We love because he first loved us.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: It is easy to love people who are nice to us, but sometimes it is hard to love people who are mean. How do we learn to love everyone? We look at God! God loved us first, even before we knew Him. Because His heart is so full of love for us, our hearts can be full of love for others.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, thank You for loving me first. Fill my heart with Your amazing love. Help me to share that love with everyone I meet today, even when it is hard. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Show love to someone in your family today without them asking. You could help set the table, share a toy with a sibling, or give someone a big hug!

verse_of_the_day.text: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: God wants us to be kind friends. Being compassionate means we care when someone else is sad or hurt. This verse also tells us to forgive. Forgiving means not staying mad when someone makes a mistake. God forgives us when we mess up, so we should forgive others too!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, help me to be a kind and gentle friend. If someone hurts my feelings, help me to forgive them quickly, just like You always forgive me. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Practice saying 'I forgive you.' If a friend or brother or sister does something that makes you upset today, try to use kind words and choose to forgive them.

verse_of_the_day.text: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Praise the Lord.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Take a deep breath in. Now let it out! If you are breathing, God wants you to praise Him! Praising God means telling Him how great He is and saying thank you for all the wonderful things He has made. We can praise Him by singing, praying, or just looking at nature.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, You are so amazing! Thank You for giving me breath and life. I praise You for making the sun, the trees, and my family. You are the best! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Sing your favorite worship song out loud today! You can clap your hands or dance around to show God how happy you are to praise Him.

verse_of_the_day.text: My dear brothers and sisters, take note of this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: God gave us two ears and one mouth for a reason! He wants us to do twice as much listening as we do talking. When we listen carefully to our parents and friends, we show them respect. If we pause and listen instead of yelling, we won't get angry so fast.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, please help me to be a good listener today. Help me to close my mouth and open my ears. When I feel angry, help me to calm down and not say mean things. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Play a listening game today! When someone is talking to you, look right into their eyes and wait for them to completely finish speaking before you say anything back.

verse_of_the_day.text: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: It is okay to feel scared sometimes. Even grown-ups get scared! But God tells us we can be brave. Being brave doesn't mean you never feel fear; it means you keep going anyway because you know God is right there by your side. He goes with you to school, to bed, and everywhere else!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, thank You for always being with me. When the dark is scary or I feel afraid, please remind me that You are holding my hand. Make me brave. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: If you go somewhere new or try something scary today, whisper to yourself: 'God is with me everywhere I go.' Notice how it makes you feel braver!

verse_of_the_day.text: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: God wants us to have happy hearts! How do we do that? By talking to Him all the time (that's what praying is!) and by saying 'thank you' for what we have. Even if we are having a bad day, we can always find at least one small thing to thank God for.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, thank You for all my blessings. Help me to remember to talk to You throughout my whole day. Give me a joyful heart that always remembers to say thank you. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Make a 'Thank You' list! Before you go to sleep tonight, count five things on your fingers that you are thankful for, and tell God thank you for each one.

verse_of_the_day.text: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine wearing shiny, heavy knight armor! God gives us invisible armor to keep us safe every day. He gives us the belt of truth, the shield of faith, and the helmet of salvation. This super cool armor protects our minds and hearts from making bad choices and helps us stand strong!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, thank You for giving me invisible armor. Help me to put on Your truth, peace, and faith today so I can be brave and strong against anything bad. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Pretend to put on your invisible armor before you leave the house today! Tap your head for your helmet, your chest for your shield, and your feet for your special shoes of peace.

verse_of_the_day.text: Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: A mustard seed is so tiny, it looks like a speck of dust! But Jesus says if you have even that tiny little bit of belief in Him, you can do huge, mind-blowing things. You don't need giant faith to do great things; you just need to put your tiny faith in a giant God!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, my faith feels small sometimes, but I know You are big. Please take my little bit of faith and use it to do amazing things. Help me to believe that nothing is impossible for You. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Draw a picture of a giant mountain and a tiny dot next to it. Write 'My God is bigger!' at the top to remind you that your faith is powerful.

verse_of_the_day.text: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Did you know there is no one else in the whole entire world exactly like you? God designed your laugh, your eyes, and the things you are good at. You are not an accident. You are God’s special masterpiece, and everything He makes is wonderful!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, thank You for making me exactly how I am. Thank You for my smile, my mind, and my heart. Help me to remember that I am Your wonderful masterpiece today. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Look in the mirror today, give yourself a big smile, and say out loud: 'God made me, and God makes wonderful things!'

verse_of_the_day.text: But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Eagles fly super high up in the sky, way above the clouds. When you feel tired, sad, or feel like giving up, God promises to give you fresh energy. He wants to help you feel so strong and joyful that it feels like you are flying high like an eagle!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, sometimes I get tired and want to quit. Please give me Your super strength today. Help me to run and not get tired, and help my spirit soar like an eagle! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: When you are playing outside today, stretch your arms out wide like eagle wings and run as fast as you can! Remember that God gives you the strength to keep going.

verse_of_the_day.text: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Think of a huge, totally unbreakable stone castle. That is what God is like! When we are in trouble, scared, or worried, we can run straight to Him by praying. He acts like a giant, strong tower that keeps us completely safe from harm.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, thank You for being my strong tower. Whenever I feel scared, remind me to run to You. Thank You for hiding me and keeping me safe. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Use blocks, Legos, or pillows to build the tallest, strongest tower you can today! Let it remind you of how strong and safe God is.

verse_of_the_day.text: The Lord does not look at the things people look at. People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: People might look at your clothes, how fast you run, or how tall you are. But God has a special kind of X-ray vision! He looks right past the outside and looks straight at your heart. He cares most about how much love, kindness, and goodness is inside of you.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, help me to have a beautiful heart. Teach me to care more about being kind and loving than about how I look on the outside. Give me eyes to see people the way You see them. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Cut a heart shape out of paper and write your name on it. Put it somewhere you can see it to remind you that God loves what is inside your heart!

verse_of_the_day.text: For no word from God will ever fail.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Have you ever tried to do something that felt totally impossible? For us, some things are just too hard to do on our own. But for God, there is zero limit to His amazing power. If God promises something, He will always do it. He never breaks a promise!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, You are incredibly powerful! Thank You that You never break Your promises. Help me to trust You even when things seem completely impossible. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Try to balance a pencil on the tip of your finger. It's really hard, right? When things feel impossible for you, remember that nothing is too hard for God!

verse_of_the_day.text: I have hidden your word in my heart that I might not sin against you.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Pirates hide shiny treasure in secret chests. We can hide something even better in our hearts—God’s words! When we read the Bible and memorize verses, we are putting God's treasure right inside of us. Then, when we need help making a good choice, the treasure is right there ready to use!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, Your words are better than gold and treasure. Help me to learn Your Bible verses and keep them safe in my heart so I can always know the right thing to do. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Go on a mini treasure hunt! Have someone hide a piece of paper with today's verse written on it somewhere in your house. When you find it, try to memorize it!

verse_of_the_day.text: You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine a totally dark room, and then someone turns on a super bright, glowing flashlight. Jesus says YOU are that light! When you are kind, when you share, and when you smile, you are shining God's bright light into the world so everyone can see how good He is.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, thank You for making me a light. Help me to shine super bright today. Let my kind words and actions help other people see Your love. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Turn off the lights in a room and turn on a flashlight. See how it chases the dark away? Look for one way to be a bright light to someone who is feeling sad today.

verse_of_the_day.text: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the old order of things has passed away.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: This is a sneak peek at the best surprise ever! God promises that one day, when we are with Him in heaven, nobody will ever cry, get hurt, or feel sick again. There won't be any more sad days or owies. It will be the happiest place forever and ever with Him!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, heaven sounds like the most wonderful place ever. Thank You for promising to wipe away all our tears one day. Help me to feel happy when I think about my future with You. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: If you get a scrape or feel sad today, let it remind you of God's amazing promise: One day He will fix everything and we will never be hurt or sad again!

verse_of_the_day.text: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine a giant, unshakeable mountain made of solid rock with a huge, safe castle right on top. That is exactly what God is like! When the world feels crazy or scary, God is our ultimate fortress. Nothing can break through His walls to get to you.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, You are my super strong rock and my safe castle. Thank You for protecting me from everything bad. Help me to always run to You when I need a safe place. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Find a cool, smooth rock outside today. Keep it in your pocket. Whenever you touch it, remember that God is your solid rock who keeps you safe!

verse_of_the_day.text: Every word of God is flawless; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Picture a glowing, unbreakable energy shield like your favorite superhero uses. God’s promises act just like that shield! Every single word in the Bible is perfectly true, and when we believe what God says, His words block out the lies and mean things that try to hurt our hearts.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, Your words are perfect and true. Thank You for being a glowing shield around me today. Help me to trust the Bible so I can block out bad thoughts and fears. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Pretend you are holding a giant, invisible shield today. When a bad thought or fear tries to sneak into your mind, say 'Block!' and remember God is protecting you.

verse_of_the_day.text: Let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Life is like a giant, epic obstacle course that God designed just for you! 'Perseverance' is a big word that means never, ever giving up. Even if you trip over a hurdle or get tired and sweaty, God is cheering for you at the finish line, telling you to keep running!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, thank You for cheering me on. When my obstacle course gets hard today, give me the energy to keep running. Help me to never give up. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Set up a mini obstacle course in your living room or yard today using pillows or toys. See how fast you can finish it without quitting!

verse_of_the_day.text: Therefore everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: If you build a sandcastle on the beach, the waves will wash it away! But if you build a house on solid rock, even the biggest hurricane can't knock it down. Listening to Jesus and doing what He says is like pouring strong, unbreakable concrete for your life so nothing can knock you over.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, I want to be wise and strong. Help me to not just hear Your words, but to actually do them. Make my life strong like a house built on a rock. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Next time you are playing with blocks or building toys, try building the tallest tower you can on a soft pillow, and then build one on the hard floor. See which one is stronger!

verse_of_the_day.text: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, 'Quiet! Be still!' Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine the craziest thunderstorm ever, with giant crashing waves and howling wind. Jesus just stood up and told the storm to 'Be quiet!' and it instantly stopped. He has superpowers over everything in the whole universe. If He can calm a massive storm, He can calm any storm inside your heart, too!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear Jesus, Your power is incredible! When my feelings get loud and stormy, please say 'peace, be still' to my heart. Thank You for being stronger than any storm. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: When you wash your hands today, splash the water around a little to make waves. Then hold your hands completely still and watch the water calm down, just like Jesus calmed the sea.

verse_of_the_day.text: That person is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: When you follow God, you are like a massive, healthy tree with roots digging deep underground right next to a cool river. Because the tree always has water, its leaves never turn brown and it grows the best, juiciest fruit! God’s love is the water that keeps you growing strong and healthy.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, I want to grow strong and tall like a healthy tree. Let Your love be the water that feeds my roots. Help me to grow good fruit like kindness and joy today. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Drink a big, refreshing glass of water today. As you drink it, imagine God’s love filling you up and making your spirit grow strong.

verse_of_the_day.text: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine you have a backpack filled with heavy, giant rocks called 'worries.' It makes you so tired to carry them! This verse says you can take off that heavy backpack and throw it right into God's giant dump truck. He wants to carry your heavy worries away because He cares about you so much.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, sometimes my worries feel too heavy to carry. Today, I am throwing them all to You. Thank You for taking my heavy backpack of fears and giving me peace instead. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Write or draw your biggest worry on a piece of paper. Then, crumple it up into a ball and throw it in the trash can as hard as you can! Say, 'God, I give this to You!'

verse_of_the_day.text: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Imagine being a secret agent whose boss is the King of the Universe! Whether you are doing homework, cleaning your room, or playing a game, do it like you are doing it directly for God. Even normal, boring chores become super important secret missions when you do them to make God smile.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Lord, help me to do my very best today. Even when I am doing chores or homework, remind me that I am actually working for You. Give me a joyful heart to finish my missions! Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Pick one chore today (like making your bed or putting away toys) and do it as perfectly and happily as you can, pretending God is coming over to inspect it!

verse_of_the_day.text: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Reading the Bible is like putting on a superhero cape, but actually doing what it says is how you fly! If we just listen to God's rules but never do them, it is like having superpowers but leaving them in the closet. God wants us to jump into action!

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Dear God, don't let me just sit around and listen. Help me to jump into action! When I read Your words, give me the courage to actually do what they say. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: Tie a blanket around your shoulders like a superhero cape for 5 minutes today. While you wear it, zoom around and do one helpful, kind action for someone in your house!

verse_of_the_day.text: My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.content: Think about a glow stick. For it to shine super bright in the dark, it actually has to be bent and cracked! Sometimes we feel weak, broken, or not good enough. But God says that is the exact moment His super-power shines the brightest right out of us.

daily_prayer.title: Daily Prayer
daily_prayer.content: Father, sometimes I feel weak and I don't know how to do things right. Thank You that You love me anyway. Shine Your amazing power through my weaknesses today. Amen.

life_application.title: Life Application
life_application.content: If you make a mistake today and feel weak, stop and say, 'It's okay! God is strong even when I am weak.' Let His power shine through you!
